audit.whatIsWrong: Every full-layer row read 'Skill' while the content layer and the packet levelChart both read LeBlanc for the first six stages and Lissandra at 2+ items. Seven rows rendered two different answers.
audit.why: Two independent sources agree on the content chart, and the kit supports it: Ring of Frost roots at only 450 and Glacial Path is 24s at rank 1, so a 925-range chain out-spaces her whole setup in lane. At two items her 80-second Frozen Tomb is the teamfight-deciding button and she stops caring about the duel.
audit.corrected: phases[0..5].side -> LeBlanc (rows 1-4 lifted to 6/10), phases[6].side -> Lissandra at 4/10, with every why rewritten to argue its row.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] labelled Glacial Path as her ultimate. Glacial Path is her E; her level 6 is Frozen Tomb, and the page never described what it actually does.
audit.why: Enemy kit: E is Glacial Path (24/21/18/15/12s, 1050 range); R is Frozen Tomb (120/100/80s, 550 range) which stuns on an enemy or heals her while making her untargetable and invulnerable on herself.
audit.corrected: spikes[1], whys[4], phases[4].why and phases[5].why rewritten around the real ultimate and its 120s rank-1 cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: The matchup-deciding interaction was absent: self-cast Frozen Tomb makes Lissandra untargetable and invulnerable, so a committed LeBlanc chain — especially a mimicked one — is wasted into it. Her sustain from the same ability was also unmentioned.
audit.why: missingInteractions rules untargetable-dodges-burst and needs-antiheal; enemy R text states both effects.
audit.corrected: dosFull[1].d, dontsFull[2].d, phases[4].why, spikes[1] and spikes[2] now tell you to bait the ice, wait it out, and buy Grievous Wounds.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit in it (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT) and described Glacial Path only in the abstract.
audit.why: Glacial Path 24/21/18/15/12s at 80-100 mana; Ring of Frost 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s at 450 range; Frozen Tomb 120/100/80s.
audit.corrected: Rewritten with all three, and with the consequence that her only lockdown requires you inside 450.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Claw Marks (W)' appeared twice — Lissandra's W is Ring of Frost. Eight fields called her he/his, and two bullets were the tradeGood/tradeBad strings pasted under unrelated titles.
audit.why: Enemy kit W; champ-gender lists Lissandra as she/her; lintFindings names each field.
audit.corrected: Fabricated name removed from spikes[0] and wants.you[1], all MISGENDER fields regendered, both bleed bullets rewritten.

audit.why: The packet flags wants.foe[1] 'Use Glacial Path' as a probable wrong ability name. It is not — Glacial Path is Lissandra's real E. Left untouched.

edits.before: Lissandra needs to land Ice Shard (Q) into Claw Marks (W) stun for any real damage, but your W-E-Q burst combo punishes her before that slow setup finishes, especially since she has no gap-closer of her own.

edits.before: Glacial Path (R) gives her a dash-and-return escape/engage tool, but a single self-root cast doesn't out-damage your Mimic reset combo, so you still hold the kill threat even as she gains more mobility.
edits.after: Her level 6 is Frozen Tomb (R), not Glacial Path (E): cast on you it stuns, cast on herself it heals her and makes her untargetable and invulnerable — so never dump Mimic into the ice, wait it out.

edits.before: Your burst spike from Luden's arrives well before Lissandra's own damage items matter, letting you punish her aggressively in the item-1 window.
edits.after: Your Stormsurge spike arrives before her damage items matter, but Frozen Tomb heals her — Grievous Wounds decides whether the burst finishes.

edits.before: Levels 3 through 6 your burst chain still lands before her Q-into-W root fully resolves, and even once Glacial Path comes online at 6 it's a single self-displacing dash rather than a burst tool, so your reset combo continues to outpace her damage output in the direct lane fight.
edits.after: Levels 3 to 6 her damage needs Ice Shard's slow to land Ring of Frost inside 450, so chain her from 925 and she never gets the root. Glacial Path is her E and it is 24 seconds at rank 1 — while it is down she cannot leave the wave you are shoving into her.

notes: The packet levelChart and the content win[] agreed, so the full layer's all-Skill chart was moved to match them; win[] needed no edits. The packet's suspectNames entry for wants.foe[1] ('Use Glacial Path') is a FALSE POSITIVE — Glacial Path is Lissandra's actual E and the line is correct; I left it alone. 'Claw Marks' was the real fabricated name and it appeared in spikes[0] and wants.you[1]. Whether LeBlanc's Ethereal Chains shackle persists through a self-cast Frozen Tomb, or is dropped by the untargetability, is not answerable from the kit text and I did not assert either way.
